LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_FairyFestival: "Everything will be peaceful while you are under the fairies' care."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_OldBeliefAndPromise: "Do not despair when you feel betrayed. A price is always paid in return."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_OneSin: "It feeds on the 'evil' seeping out during conversations between people."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_WeCanChangeAnything: "We will turn all of you into something even better than before."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_WellCheers: "Somewhere in the distance, you hear seagulls."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_FragmentOfTheUniverse: "You see a song in front of you. It is approaching, becoming colorful and louder."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_HeartOfAspiration: "Overbearing eagerness often drives a person straight into their own ruin."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_MeatLantern: "A pale flower beckons softly, hiding lethal teeth beneath the soil."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_Ppodae: "When I grow bigger, nobody will ever look down on me again!"
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_PunishingBird: "People have been committing sins since long ago. 'Why do they commit sins, knowing it is wrong?'"
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_ScorchedGirl: "I am coming to you. You, who will be reduced to ashes just like me."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_VoidDream: "Please eat my dreams before they carry me away forever."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_AllAroundHelper: "The sirens grow louder. Blood stains everything across the room."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_DerFreischutz: "This magical bullet can truly hit anyone, just like you say."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_FuneralOfDeadButterflie: "Where does one go when they die?"
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_Laetitia: "She was so sad that she had to leave her dear friends behind, so she came up with a brilliant idea!"
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_NotesFromCrazedResearch: "Once the experiment succeeds, you may die... or even wish that you could."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_PortraitOfAnotherWorld: "From the moment my likeness stepped into that frame, we began sharing a single breath."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_ScarecrowSearchingForWi: "The city was still a place of cold, hollow beauty, and the streets were filled with mindless people."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_Schadenfreude: "Don't look at me. Look away, before its keyhole opens wide."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_SnowQueen: "The forest is asleep in the deep snow, waiting for spring inside a palace of ice."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_WarmHeartedWoodsman: "A warm heart full of leaden thumps beats softly inside its hollow iron chest."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_BackwardClock: "Turn the hands back to the past, at the price of a soul erased from time."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_BigBird: "Its many golden eyes burn brightly, for no monster may harm the creatures of the forest."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_BurrowingHeaven: "Keep your eyes fixed upon it, so that its crimson wings cannot reach the heavens."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_JudgementBird: "Its scale was utterly fair, never neglecting even the smallest trace of sin."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_LittleRedRidingHoodedMe: "I'll hang that bastard's head over my bed. Only then can I finally sleep through the night."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_FleshIdol: "The price of our faith shall forever be paid by blood and flesh."
LanguageData.LC_Extract_Quote_NothingThere: "And the many shells cried out one single word... 'Manager!'"
